note: Frozen evaluation questions for the Commercialization Advisor. Written by reading the policy corpus sections, before any retrieval tuning, and not edited afterwards (tests/test_eval_gold.py pins the file's hash). A policy item counts as a hit when one of the first five quoted passages comes from an expected source and, where expect_phrase is given, contains that phrase. These are the team's questions, not real faculty questions, and 18 policy items is a small sample, so read results as a regression check, not as accuracy.
